requests.message: Hi, my trail running shoes from order ORD-1042 arrived with the sole coming off. Can I get a refund please?
requests.why: Defective item, delivered 15 days ago (within 30-day rule R3), 89.00 is under the 200.00 auto-approve limit, no recent refund pattern.

requests.message: I don't really like the wireless headphones I bought (ORD-1017). I'd like my money back.
requests.why: Electronics change of mind is only accepted within 15 days of delivery (R2); delivered 2026-08-20, 66 days ago.

requests.message: The laptop from ORD-1055 won't turn on at all. I want a full refund.

requests.message: The dress from ORD-1031 doesn't fit me, please refund it.
requests.why: Within the 30-day window (R1), but the customer already had 3 approved refunds in the last 90 days (R8).

requests.message: My dinner set (ORD-1060) still hasn't arrived and it's been more than three weeks.

requests.message: The air fryer from ORD-1048 stopped working. Refund please.
requests.why: Order ORD-1048 was already refunded on 2026-09-28 (RF-2004); an order can be refunded only once (R9).
